_about: Every file that can send a message to a customer. Checked by scripts/check-outbound-copy-gate.py (rules in its docstring). `gated` = cannot reach its POST without a reviewer verdict bound to the sha256 of the bytes (scripts/outbound_copy/gate.py, asked through sendgate.py or lib/copy_gate.py), proven on the AST. `gated_elsewhere` = behind the same gate in a shape the AST rule cannot read; `checked_by` names the test that proves it. `open` = not behind the gate yet; the owner lane wires it.

senders.why: bash: it pipes the exact payload body to gate.py check between the ledger claim and its one customer POST and holds on any answer but an approval; the `copy gate` bats cases run the real gate.py against it
that lane wires its own senders to the same gate (its inbox note of 2026-11-12 01:18Z)

copy_hold() asks lib/copy_gate and returns the hold as a rejected send instead of raising, so the ladder records it and asks again next tick; CopyGateTests pin that a held Intercom body or email line is never posted
sends a template key plus data to send-gateway /v1/send rather than a finished body; what the gate hashes has to be settled first

senders.family: bulk send queue (email route; ships unarmed)
senders.why: a batch sender: EmailRoute.hold() asks lib/copy_gate for every distinct body of a claimed batch and returns the hold per job instead of raising, so a held body gives its claim back and is never handed to the one exec that POSTs the rest
locked today (COPY_APPROVED=0, dry-run default); posts through intercom-ops-write.sh

senders.family: replies through the writer: agent replies on a signed verdict, staff-requested replies, the gdpr-erasure purpose
senders.why: one of its three classes is behind the gate: a reply sent with --agent/--gate-campaign runs `gate.py check` in the writer and posts only on a signed approve (the `verdict class` cases of scripts/tests/intercom-ops-write.bats). The other two are not: a staff-requested reply is approved by the named person and no reviewer reads it, and a gdpr-erasure letter is not asked about here (its caller, scripts/gdpr_pipeline/send.py, has its own row)

senders.family: resolution-matcher (a shipped fix, told to its reporters)

senders.why: fixed acknowledgement mailed from support@ through gog
intercom-webhook.service posts replies into conversations; not a verification notifier, no per-message verdict
conversational replies pass caroline-output-guard.ts; a per-message verdict needs a reviewer node-8 can reach in seconds, which does not exist yet

not_senders.why: removes gog send from an agent's tool list; sends nothing
a CI check that names the reply endpoint in its messages
its one reply call is post_internal_note with message_type fixed to note; it moves assignments and posts nothing a customer sees
